comment: The README says the modulator covers 11Hz to 55Hz; the code gives 0.17Hz to 55Hz in the Lo range and 11.3Hz to 1760Hz in the Hi range, and the frequency tooltip reads in Hz for the Hi range only, so it is wrong in Lo. The maker's tooltips name the delay section reverb while the panel prints only TIME, FBACK and WET, and the README calls it a delay. The preamp's Off position is PREAMPSRC_FEEDBACK in the source, a feedback path that is not implemented and returns silence. The Gate 2 level is not clamped before use because of a typo that clamps the Gate 1 variable instead, so Gate 2 modulation can push its level past the slider range; Gate 1 has already been computed by then, so nothing else is disturbed. The INVERT input and the MOD output have no family: the inverter carries whatever is patched into it, and the modulator output is an LFO or an audio-rate wave according to its RANGE switch.
